Knip's vitest plugin only registers setupFiles/globalSetup as entry points when 'unlisted' or 'dependencies' is part of the requested --include set, so every drift-ai check sharing this knip spawn (orphan-files, unused-exports, knip-duplicates, all built from the same KNIP_*_INCLUDE_CATEGORIES constants) inherits this false-positive class wherever a file is reachable only via a vitest-plugin-driven entry.
confirmed.verifyNote: Fully reproduced. Ran the exact flags knip-runner.ts builds for orphan-files-only selection (`knip --reporter json --include files --no-progress`) against the live repo: 10 files reported as orphaned, including packages/client/src/test/setup.ts, packages/server/src/test/setup.ts, packages/server/src/test/global-setup.ts, and 4 mock-*.ts/tsx files. Verified these ARE wired: packages/client/vitest.config.ts:20 and packages/server/vitest.config.ts:21 set setupFiles: ['src/test/setup.ts'], and packages/server/vitest.config.ts:22 sets globalSetup; setup.ts statically imports mock-map-token-mutations.ts (line 11) and dynamically imports mock-react-konva/mock-roll-toast/mock-scroll-area inside vi.mock() factories (lines 56/60/74). Re-running with --include files,unlisted or files,dependencies drops the list to 3 genuine orphans, matching a bare `bun run knip`. Critically, also tested the actual production scenario this audit used ('every check enabled', which resolveKnipIncludeCategories maps to key '111' -> KNIP_INCLUDE_CATEGORIES = files,exports,types,enumMembers,namespaceMembers,duplicates) and the false positive PERSISTS (still 10 files, same 7 false positives) because KNIP_INCLUDE_CATEGORIES never includes 'unlisted' or 'dependencies' under any of drift-ai's 7 category-selection keys (checked INCLUDE_CATEGORIES_BY_SELECTION in knip-runner.ts:128-136 and the fallback default) -- so this bug affects 100% of drift-ai knip-backed check combinations, not just a narrow edge case. Confirmed the target's own root knip.config.ts has no exemption for this (ignoreIssues entries there cover exports/types categories on specific globs, nothing for the files/orphan category or these test-infra paths). Confirmed knip-orphan-files.ts is a pure Tier-1 pass-through adapter with no additional filtering that would catch this. Since resolveKnipIncludeCategories/memoizingDefaultKnipRunner share one spawn and cache key across whatever knip-backed checks are selected, unused-exports and knip-duplicates checks inherit the same distorted report. This is a systematic, unmitigated, high-confidence false-positive generator in the repo's own dogfooded tooling (scripts/drift-ai), which per project weighting guidance should be treated as high priority.
